lines: Before ChatGPT recommends you, it checks your pricing page.
One search in eleven goes straight to a single vendor's own website.
One in eight asks for official information.
Hide your pricing, and the page that shows it wins.
See what ChatGPT searches about your brand with SupaIntent.
profile: American female, about 40, marketing lead explaining one sharp finding to a peer. Dry, deadpan wit with a smile in the voice, confident, lively, ~185 WPM, close-mic.
music: Instrumental only, no vocals. Light detective-style office groove: pizzicato bass, brushed snare, soft vibraphone, sly and playful, 104 BPM, 30 seconds.
